sources.name: NDIC HIDTA Drug Market Analyses (U.S. DOJ, archived) and HIDTA drug threat assessments
sources.citation: U.S. Department of Justice, National Drug Intelligence Center, HIDTA Drug Market Analyses 2009/2011; Atlanta-Carolinas HIDTA, 2026 Drug Threat Assessment. Each route cites its report, PDF page and verbatim quote.

sources.name: Natural Earth 1:10m populated places and admin-0 label points
sources.citation: Natural Earth (public domain), ne_10m_populated_places_simple and ne_10m_admin_0_countries; placement anchors for the estimated-flow layer only.

notes: Documented routes: each states one drug moving between two places, quoted from a public US government report (mostly 2008-2011 NDIC HIDTA Drug Market Analyses). Absence of a route is not evidence of absence.
Places are no more precise than the source: state label point when only a state is named, country anchor for foreign origins. Checked against the model in docs/US_ROUTES_VALIDATION.md.

source.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice, National Drug Intelligence Center
source.title: Midwest High Intensity Drug Trafficking Area Drug Market Analysis 2011
source.quote: Mexican DTOs in St. Louis have primary sources of supply in Phoenix and Tucson; they also acquire heroin, cocaine, methamphetamine, and marijuana from sources in Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, El Paso, Houston, and Los Angeles.
